title: Validation of HRV Studio: A Transparent and Quality-Control-Aware Platform for Heart Rate Variability Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2608.24241v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reproducibility of heart rate variability (HRV) analysis is limited by differences in preprocessing and computational conventions across software platforms. We developed HRV Studio, an open-source PyQt6-based desktop application integrating transparent HRV analysis with automated quality-control (QC) diagnostics. Validation included large-scale agreement with NeuroKit2, targeted Kubios benchmarking, spectral-method comparison, synthetic perturbation testing, recording-duration sensitivity analysis, and arrhythmia-focused QC stress testing. HRV Studio showed near-identical agreement for the widely used time-domain indices RMSSD and SDNN under matched conditions. In the primary five-minute NeuroKit2 comparison, frequency-domain median relative errors were 1.35% for LF, 0.18% for HF, and 1.41% for LF/HF, while VLF remained more convention-sensitive (37.79%). Nonlinear Poincar\'e indices also demonstrated high consistency. Sequence-harmoni

translated_title: HRV Studio验证：一个透明且质量控制意识强的心率变异性分析平台
translated_abstract: 心率变异性（HRV）分析的可重复性受限于不同软件平台在预处理和计算约定上的差异。我们开发了HRV Studio，一个基于PyQt6的开源桌面应用程序，将透明的HRV分析与自动化质量控制（QC）诊断相结合。验证包括与NeuroKit2的大规模一致性比较、针对Kubios的基准测试、频谱方法比较、合成扰动测试、记录时长敏感性分析以及以心律失常为重点的QC压力测试。HRV Studio在匹配条件下，对广泛使用的时间域指标RMSSD和SDNN显示出近乎一致的一致性。在主要的五分钟NeuroKit2比较中，频域中位相对误差为：低频（LF）1.35%，高频（HF）0.18%，低频/高频比（LF/HF）1.41%，而极低频（VLF）仍对约定较为敏感（37.79%）。非线性庞加莱指数也表现出高度一致性。序列调和...
tldr: HRV Studio是一个开源、透明且集成自动化质量控制的心率变异性分析平台，通过与现有工具的大规模验证，在大多数指标上实现高一致性，解决了HRV分析的可重复性问题。
en_tdlr: HRV Studio is an open-source, transparent, and quality-control-aware platform for heart rate variability analysis that achieves high consistency across most metrics through large-scale validation against existing tools, addressing reproducibility issues in HRV analysis.
